title.zh: UK chances of keeping £3.8bn bitcoin haul rise after High Court ruling
title.en: UK chances of keeping £3.8bn bitcoin haul rise after High Court ruling

current_state.zh: A UK High Court ruling has improved the British government's chances of permanently retaining a seized bitcoin hoard worth roughly £3.8bn, strengthening the legal footing for state confiscation of the crypto assets.
